capture.zh: 在通天塔挑战斯克鲁（魔神艾里克的部下），打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 未找到同期攻略；冰系，火、战斗、机械、地面系克制。

engine_notes: No 2012 source for this fight was found. Rules (immune_pct_damage, immune_status, innate atk+2) are a placeholder modelled on the neighbouring 螺旋星系 SPT bosses (帕里斯 2012-08, 纳特 2012-10) and must be verified.
skills: sources name no (or only some) boss skills; the team uses the species' four top learnset skills (Lv49-61). Every 2011-2012 SPT boss whose skills a source does list used exactly these four.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
source_note: Only species data and the game's SPT list (habitat 通天塔) were found; era inferred from species id between 帕里斯 and 纳特.
